response.drought.0: Trace the stream to its springs
consequence.drought.0: Scouts find water between two rocks.
consequence.drought.1: Each family gets a share, but gathering slows.
consequence.drought.2: People dig in the gravel as the berries on the bank shrivel.
consequence.dryHarvest.0: Even the last to arrive receive a portion.
consequence.dryHarvest.1: The baskets return full, thinning the tuber beds.
consequence.dryHarvest.2: Supplies last a little longer, at a cost to the weakest.
consequence.winter.0: Everyone eats tonight. Even the roots set aside for the thaw are used up.
response.winter.1: Organise a hunt in the snow
consequence.winter.1: Meat comes back to camp alongside hunters with frostbite.
response.winter.2: Take the outlying families into the central shelters
consequence.winter.2: Sharing fires saves wood and keeps the children warm. Displaced families lose their own hearths and dispute how space is divided.
consequence.split.0: Both circles again choose their route together.
response.split.1: Let the camps take turns leading hunts
consequence.split.1: Leadership changes hands. The hunters still dispute the catch.
consequence.split.2: Each hearth fends for itself and watches the other’s catch.
response.feud.0: Compensate the families who lost out
consequence.feud.0: Returning the hides lets the families share a fire again.
consequence.feud.1: Hunters avoid clashes but give up some trails.
response.feud.2: Wait until the next hunt to decide
consequence.feud.2: The trackers set out still divided.
response.inherit.0: Entrust the stories to several witnesses
consequence.inherit.0: If one voice falls silent, others still remember the way.
consequence.inherit.1: One voice keeps the genealogy and gains authority.
response.inherit.2: Let each hearth remember its own
consequence.inherit.2: The hearths begin telling different versions.
consequence.injury.0: The wounded drink and rest while the others hunt.
consequence.injury.1: Wounds are dressed, leaving fewer hides against the cold.
consequence.injury.2: Relatives tend the injured, leaving the hunt unfinished.
consequence.spring.0: Even those who missed the discovery can now find the spring.
consequence.spring.1: Water is close, but a hunting trail is left behind.
consequence.spring.2: Gatherers remember the route for the dry season.
consequence.nuts.0: Families with fewer nuts can eat alongside the others.
consequence.nuts.1: New groves fill baskets at the cost of longer marches.
response.nuts.2: Leave some nuts beneath the trees
consequence.nuts.2: Meals shrink, but the woodland keeps its seeds.
consequence.flocks.0: Lookouts learn where the flocks settle.
consequence.flocks.1: The hunt pays off far from the familiar shelter.
response.flocks.2: Wait for the birds to return
consequence.flocks.2: The camp stays together on less meat.
response.embers.0: Set a night watch over the embers
consequence.embers.0: The keepers learn to rekindle the embers and show children how to preserve fire until morning.
consequence.embers.1: The fire lasts until dawn, thinning the undergrowth.
consequence.embers.2: People learn to rekindle a fire with a handful of twigs.
consequence.singers.0: A shared refrain travels from one hearth to another.
response.singers.1: Teach the song to the children
consequence.singers.1: The youngest remember names through rhythm.
consequence.singers.2: Different verses preserve details of the same journey.
consequence.trail.0: On their return, fresh tracks help everyone decide.
response.trail.1: Take the trail with more game
consequence.trail.1: Bags fill, though some still favour the other route.
consequence.trail.2: The parties split up knowing where to reunite.
consequence.guests.0: The newcomers find places beside the fire.
response.guests.1: Ask the guests to lead a hunt
consequence.guests.1: Their knowledge of the tracks brings meat to camp.
consequence.guests.2: At dawn the families part after exchanging news.
consequence.shell.0: The promise now has witnesses on both banks.
consequence.shell.1: Each telling of the shell’s journey renews the promise.
consequence.shell.2: The gift loses authority but needs no keeper.
consequence.smoke.0: Smoke no longer drifts back over the sleeping mats.
consequence.smoke.1: Air circulates better, at the cost of a cold draught.
response.smoke.2: Cook outside until the wind shifts
consequence.smoke.2: The shelters clear, but cooking takes more wood.
consequence.coldwater.0: Experienced swimmers help the children across.
consequence.coldwater.1: The ford is shallow, but the detour cuts into hunting time.
response.coldwater.2: Wait on the bank for sunlight
consequence.coldwater.2: The group crosses later, once the ice on the stones melts.
consequence.caregivers.0: More hands learn to recognise a fever in the night.
consequence.caregivers.1: Night watches become regular, with fewer baskets coming home.
consequence.caregivers.2: Relatives take turns beside the sleeping mat.
consequence.shelters.0: Dry mats help coughs ease sooner.
consequence.shelters.1: Camp is drier and farther from the berry bushes.
response.shelters.2: Gather the mats beneath the overhang
consequence.shelters.2: The group shares the remaining dry space.
consequence.grazing.0: Grass returns where the herd has moved on.
response.grazing.1: Post herders on the field edges
consequence.grazing.1: Herders protect the crop at the cost of other work.
consequence.grazing.2: Pastures recover, but the village has less milk.
response.storeroom.0: Share the surplus with nearby villages
consequence.storeroom.0: The sacks leave the yard and neighbours remember the gift.
consequence.storeroom.1: Less grain sits outdoors, and new hoes arrive.
response.storeroom.2: Let the animals feed on the spill
consequence.storeroom.2: The spill disappears, but mice learn the way.
consequence.flood.0: The new homes stay dry, farther from the old plots.
consequence.flood.1: Some of the floodwater now flows around the houses.
response.flood.2: Give the low fields back to the river
consequence.flood.2: The banks turn to wetland again, reducing the area sown.
consequence.common.0: More families share oversight of the granary.
consequence.common.1: The piles are measured in sight of those waiting.
response.common.2: Open the store at the first frost
consequence.common.2: Those with little may enter, and the reserve shrinks.
consequence.crowding.0: Standing water drains from the lanes.
consequence.crowding.1: Homes have room again, but families work farther apart.
consequence.crowding.2: Water lingers at the doorsteps, and fevers spread.
consequence.fever.0: Sick families can rest without going outdoors.
response.fever.1: Set aside a hut for nursing
consequence.fever.1: Care is brought together under one roof.
consequence.fever.2: Contact drops, along with opportunities to help.
consequence.wells.0: Soil no longer slides into the well water.
consequence.wells.1: Water runs clear again, but carrying it takes workers.
response.wells.2: Wait for the mud to settle
consequence.wells.2: Jugs fill slowly as the sediment sinks.
response.animals.0: Move the pens away from homes
consequence.animals.0: Bedding stays cleaner, though watching the pens takes a walk.
consequence.animals.1: Every household knows when to clear out the pens.
consequence.animals.2: More animals sleep away, leaving less milk close to home.
response.exchange.1: Take the surplus down the trail
consequence.exchange.1: The village gains blades by giving up stored food.
consequence.exchange.2: Two households learn what is needed beyond the hill.
response.seed.0: Protect a reserve of seed grain
consequence.seed.0: Next season’s sowing is secured at the cost of smaller bowls today.
consequence.seed.1: Growers learn which varieties endure dry weather.
consequence.seed.2: Sowing is less dependent on a single store.
response.mice.0: Raise the grain bins off the ground
consequence.mice.0: Fewer sacks are reached and the floors grow cleaner.
consequence.mice.1: The tracks finally stop at the threshold.
consequence.mice.2: Stores fall, but spoiled grain leaves the village.
consequence.creek.0: Downstream plots get a turn as well.
consequence.creek.1: Less water escapes before it reaches the plots.
consequence.creek.2: The stream recovers while part of the field stays dry.
consequence.saplings.0: Saplings take root and hold the hillside together.
response.saplings.1: Keep strips of trees between fields
consequence.saplings.1: Roots hold soil along the furrows.
consequence.saplings.2: Wood comes in slowly without felling the new trees.
response.crafters.0: Seat the toolmakers in the assembly
consequence.crafters.0: The hands that shape the blades now help decide the shares.
consequence.crafters.1: Toolmakers receive a visible share of the stores.
consequence.crafters.2: The craft spreads beyond the households that guarded it.
consequence.fences.0: Travellers pass through the enclosures without climbing fences.
consequence.fences.1: A new passage meets both families’ needs.
consequence.fences.2: The walk grows longer, but herds stay out of the yards.
response.mourning.0: Keep a place for each family
consequence.mourning.0: Families with different rites find room in the same mound.
response.mourning.1: Lay out a path of remembrance
consequence.mourning.1: The stones preserve names that might have vanished.
response.mourning.2: Let relatives choose their own sites
consequence.mourning.2: Graves spread out while families keep their choice.
consequence.repair.0: Fresh thatch holds and every household has done a share.
consequence.repair.1: The repair is quick and costs several baskets of grain.
consequence.repair.2: Discussion resumes while the shelter still leaks.
consequence.slopes.0: Families sleep clear of the landslide path.
consequence.slopes.1: Terraces hold the soil and absorb much of the village’s labour.
response.slopes.2: Mark the signs of slipping earth
consequence.slopes.2: Cracks are recognised before the rains.
consequence.cistern.0: The common water stays cleaner beneath its new cover.
response.cistern.1: Assign each home a water jar
consequence.cistern.1: Families know what share must last until night.
consequence.cistern.2: Water is saved for drinking by forgoing irrigation.
consequence.shade.0: Workers can rest in shade beside the furrows.
consequence.shade.1: Cooler shifts avoid the heat but disrupt family meals.
consequence.shade.2: Workers rest while part of the harvest waits.
consequence.winterHouses.0: Stale indoor air clears more quickly.
consequence.winterHouses.1: Fewer people crowd into the same room.
response.winterHouses.2: Set aside beds for those who cough
consequence.winterHouses.2: Contact falls, along with visits to the sick.
response.marketDay.0: Agree on weights and market days
consequence.marketDay.0: Travellers arrive together and use the same measures.
consequence.marketDay.1: The stalls gather in a place everyone knows.
consequence.marketDay.2: Each village comes to know its neighbours on home ground.
consequence.silt.0: Water flows again. The crews work through harvest and part of the crop stays in the fields.
consequence.silt.1: The scribe updates the boundaries and growers demand common measures.
consequence.silt.2: Some soil recovers at the cost of a smaller harvest.
response.ledger.0: Forgive debts from the failed harvest
consequence.ledger.0: Families keep their plots while creditors write off the loans.
consequence.ledger.1: Debtors and scribes must agree on the weight owed.
consequence.ledger.2: The loan stays on the tablet, but nobody loses a home today.
consequence.weights.0: Loads become comparable. Stalls awaiting the new weights keep goods off the market.
response.weights.1: Let paired merchants check the scales
consequence.weights.1: Two witnesses verify every large shipment.
response.weights.2: Calibrate loads on the pattern cart
consequence.weights.2: Weights are checked against the load an axle can carry.
response.quarrel.0: Choose mediators by lot from both squares
consequence.quarrel.0: Both squares recognise someone at the negotiating table.
response.quarrel.1: Enter the proposals in a common register
consequence.quarrel.1: Petitions become visible and paperwork starts to pile up.
response.quarrel.2: Hear the two squares on alternate days
consequence.quarrel.2: Clashes ease, though the two sides seldom meet.
consequence.roadSickness.0: The hospices shelter the sick, but shared wards expose other travellers to infection.
consequence.roadSickness.1: Illness spreads more slowly in the squares, and trade slows too.
consequence.roadSickness.2: Those continuing their journey carry a full flask.
consequence.clerks.0: Each field appears once and the queues shorten.
consequence.clerks.1: Citizens find a scribe nearby, though each district now rules for itself.
consequence.clerks.2: Waits shrink while a few accounts remain unresolved.
consequence.creed.0: Wagons return to the bridge. Some communities must give up their holy days to take part.
consequence.creed.1: Families can observe the festivals of their own village.
response.creed.2: Leave the dates to each village
consequence.creed.2: Local customs endure while trade stays difficult.
response.borderTax.0: Replace the toll with a common fund
consequence.borderTax.0: The bridge reopens. Both banks pledge even the money set aside for future repairs.
consequence.borderTax.1: Beams are replaced, though crossing still costs money.
response.borderTax.2: Grant the boatmen a seasonal fair
consequence.borderTax.2: Boats gather at the bridge. Without new markets the stalls will eventually disappear.
response.shortage.0: Buy bread for the poorest districts
consequence.shortage.0: Bread reaches the poorest districts. To pay for it the town delays its clerks’ wages.
consequence.shortage.1: Wagons bring flour from outside. If the harvest is late, the town still owes the debt and interest.
consequence.shortage.2: Flour goes from feast kitchens to neighbourhood ovens. Districts that already paid accuse the council of theft.
response.pamphlets.0: Open a hall for public debate
consequence.pamphlets.0: Signatories and opponents debate the same pamphlet face to face.
consequence.pamphlets.1: The reply documents the facts, but its official seal leads some readers to distrust the debate.
consequence.pamphlets.2: Printers gain room while the authorities lose the first word.
consequence.credit.0: A single shipwreck no longer ruins one port.
consequence.credit.1: Risky loans fall, along with the money available.
response.credit.2: Bring guarantors to the boatmen’s fair
consequence.credit.2: Guarantors meet the crews. Boats return and the stalls are renewed.
consequence.soil.0: Soil recovers while some fields lie fallow.
consequence.soil.1: Farms compare fertility and yields on the same plots.
consequence.soil.2: Soil holds more moisture while short-term yields fall.
response.strike.1: Hold talks with the factory owners
consequence.strike.1: Owners return with demands about public works.
consequence.strike.2: Workers can meet while negotiations continue.
consequence.cityAir.0: The filters cut smoke. Some workshops close under the costs and seek city relief.
consequence.cityAir.1: Air near homes improves, but the journey to work grows longer.
response.cityAir.2: Teach evening classes for filter mechanics
consequence.cityAir.2: Mechanics learn to repair the filters. Each generation must train new apprentices.
consequence.lobby.0: Terms become public and other builders can compete.
response.lobby.1: Include workers’ housing in the contract
consequence.lobby.1: Housing goes up quickly. In return the consortium secures a multiyear claim on public funds.
consequence.lobby.2: More firms stay independent while construction slows.
consequence.wards.0: Mild cases receive care before reaching the wards.
consequence.wards.1: Stretchers clear and the budget needs new priorities.
consequence.wards.2: Vacant beds in one city take patients from another.
consequence.subsidies.0: Income support arrives immediately. The treasury defers wages and maintenance to pay for it.
consequence.subsidies.1: People changing trades find courses and trial contracts.
consequence.subsidies.2: Covered families keep their benefits while others wait.
consequence.heat.0: More water reaches homes without increasing withdrawals.
consequence.heat.1: Households get water ahead of the thirstiest crops.
consequence.heat.2: Communities can compare allocations and discuss waste.
consequence.polarization.0: People used to different sources hear one another directly.
consequence.polarization.1: Inspectors uncover abuses. Several nodes remain blocked during the investigation.
consequence.polarization.2: Neighbours regain a place to discuss the same events.
consequence.burnout.0: Work messages can wait until the following day.
consequence.burnout.1: Rest becomes predictable while responses take longer.
response.burnout.2: Use night classes to redesign shifts
consequence.burnout.2: Students try shorter shifts and train new shift leaders.
consequence.servers.0: The network stays accessible outside the largest operators.
consequence.servers.1: Users can leave a provider without losing their archive.
consequence.servers.2: Communities can finally see who can shut a node down.
consequence.orbitCare.0: Clinics open in every habitat, using the funds set aside for backup convoys.
consequence.orbitCare.1: Crews can treat emergencies even when links fail.
response.orbitCare.2: Connect clinics to the mutual aid fund
consequence.orbitCare.2: Pooled contributions cover treatment even where the medical convoy is late.
consequence.automationGap.0: The dividend supports incomes. The habitats guarantee payment even if production stops.
consequence.automationGap.1: Habitat residents ask for a voice in how their ports are run.
consequence.automationGap.2: Paid hours are spread across more households.
consequence.newHarbor.0: The habitats can negotiate through a council of their choosing.
consequence.newHarbor.1: Convoys gain a place of refuge between orbits.
consequence.newHarbor.2: The next rotation brings provisions while autonomy remains under discussion.
response.ledger.3: Buy the debts with palace grain
consequence.ledger.3: Debtors keep their fields. Few rations remain in the palace granary.
consequence.clerks.3: The backlog shrinks. Granaries must estimate how much each household receives.
consequence.shortage.3: The ovens reopen today. Many fields will lie empty in spring.
consequence.strike.3: The workshops reopen as tensions grow between families at the gates.
consequence.wards.3: The wards reopen. Rural patients miss appointments for weeks.
response.servers.3: Consolidate archives in one public node
consequence.servers.3: The archives reopen. One outage could now shut down every service.
consequence.newHarbor.3: The yards obtain credit. Every habitat is now liable if the port defaults.
response.guests.3: Give the visitors the large shelter
consequence.guests.3: The visitors sleep in the dry. Several families crowd into a shelter where people are already coughing.
consequence.wells.3: The stones laid by your ancestors guide families to clean water.
response.heat.3: Connect the old spring to the fountains
consequence.heat.3: Neighbourhood fountains draw from the spring the first settlers found.
response.silt.3: Resow the plots from the seed store
consequence.silt.3: Stored seed lets farmers sow again as soon as the water drains.
response.soil.3: Sow varieties kept in the seed store
consequence.soil.3: Families grow the old varieties on soils where they still thrive.
response.quarrel.3: Bring both squares to the hearth council
consequence.quarrel.3: At the site of the first assembly, both squares elect their mediators together.
response.creed.3: Ask the hearth council to settle the calendar
consequence.creed.3: The communities return to the circle to agree on shared days.
response.lobby.3: Put the injury fund in workers’ hands
consequence.lobby.3: Families pool their first contributions to open a mutual aid hall.
event.cartAxle.title: The first cart
event.cartAxle.body: A wheel turns around an axle. The harvesters want to try it on the trail.
response.cartAxle.0: Build a cart and teach axle making
consequence.cartAxle.0: The first cart carries the sheaves. A pattern wheel stays in the workshop.
response.cartAxle.1: Store the harvest closer to the fields
consequence.cartAxle.1: The grain travels less and families keep separate stores.
event.romanPaving.title: A road through the valley
event.romanPaving.body: Surveyors propose a paved route modelled on Roman roads. The village must decide who will maintain it.
response.romanPaving.0: Pave the road and set milestones
consequence.romanPaving.0: Paving follows the old trail. Milestones record distances for later generations.
consequence.romanPaving.1: Each hamlet repairs the stretch it uses to reach the fields.
event.citizensCharter.title: Echoes of the French Revolution
event.citizensCharter.body: A declaration of rights is read in the square. Families ask how it will shape local decisions.
response.citizensCharter.0: Engrave a charter on the civic hall
consequence.citizensCharter.0: The charter becomes public. Future councils will have to answer to its words.
consequence.citizensCharter.1: Residents attend meetings and debate each petition.
event.worldWarLetters.title: Letters from the world wars
event.worldWarLetters.body: Families bring letters, names of the missing and addresses of people who offered shelter. Where should they be kept?
response.worldWarLetters.0: Gather names and testimonies in a memorial
consequence.worldWarLetters.0: Stone tablets name the missing. The archive preserves the routes used for civilian relief.
response.worldWarLetters.1: Return the letters to the families
consequence.worldWarLetters.1: Each household chooses which voices to pass to its children.
consequence.subsidies.3: Former students teach people who lost their jobs. The school trains another generation.
event.orbitalCrossing.title: The crossing between habitats
event.orbitalCrossing.body: Several habitats share an orbital crossing. Dock operators and food carriers disagree about tolls.
consequence.orbitalCrossing.0: Carriers adapt to the timetable, with longer waits.
consequence.orbitalCrossing.1: Queues shorten, but every habitat depends on one operator.
consequence.orbitalCrossing.2: Habitats share maintenance as the two riverbanks once did. Food travels toll-free.
response.orbitalCrossing.3: Model the stations on the milestones
consequence.orbitalCrossing.3: Distances and maintenance duties are marked along the entire route.
response.orbitCare.3: Revive the memorial’s civilian relief network
consequence.orbitCare.3: Relief accounts inspire pairs of habitats to share beds and staff.
response.automationGap.3: Extend charter rights to the habitats
consequence.automationGap.3: The charter gives a voice to people whose jobs were automated.
response.winterHouses.3: Build common hearths with separate flues
consequence.winterHouses.3: The fire keepers teach households to draw smoke away from the beds.
heritage.duration: Lasts three eras. Using it renews the tradition.
heritage.renew: Using this tradition renews it for three eras.
log.heritageLost: The tradition of {name} has died out.
event.habitatWorkshop.title: Workshops without spares
event.habitatWorkshop.body: The last spare bearing has broken. The greenhouses and clinics share the same carts. Who can spare a delivery or a team of mechanics?
consequence.habitatWorkshop.0: Every district keeps a food run. Clinics wait longer for oxygen cylinders and medicines.
response.habitatWorkshop.1: Trade maintenance metal for spare bearings
consequence.habitatWorkshop.1: The carts run again. Promised habitat repairs stop and administrators must renegotiate the contracts.
consequence.habitatWorkshop.2: The school’s instructors teach crews to make the parts locally. Greenhouse mechanics leave part of the harvest uncollected to attend.
consequence.habitatWorkshop.3: The wheelwrights’ pattern axle gets workshops producing again. Habitats with older carts are left out and demand their share.
consequence.orbitCare.1.overload: Trainees leave shifts uncovered. With clinics already overloaded, the waiting list grows.
consequence.orbitalCrossing.0.overload: With the docks already congested, waiting for a free slot holds up food convoys too.
event.orbitCare.body: The habitats rely on medical convoys. When clinics fill up, coordinating transport also strains the administration. Local infrastructure can absorb some of the load.
deferred.winter.0: At the thaw there will be too little stored food for a fresh start.
deferred.dryHarvest.1: The tuber beds dug up today will be slow to regrow.
deferred.drought.1: Using the water now leaves the fruit-tree nurseries dry.
deferred.dryHarvest.2: Children raised on reduced rations will be more vulnerable in the next season.
deferred.storeroom.1: The tools will last, but there will be less grain for the next sowing.
deferred.grazing.2: A smaller herd will produce fewer calves.
deferred.cistern.2: Without irrigation part of the next sowing will be lost.
deferred.ledger.2: The deferred interest falls due at the next era change.
deferred.shortage.0: The next council will have to pay the wage arrears.
deferred.shortage.1: Convoy repayments will weigh on the next budget.
deferred.shortage.2: Districts will pass the claim for compensation to their delegates.
deferred.shortage.3: Grain milled today cannot be planted next era.
deferred.wards.2: Transfers leave home districts with a backlog of appointments.
deferred.cityAir.1: Relocated workshops carry their fumes to the outlying homes.
deferred.heat.0: Repair crews will still be committed beyond the era change.
consequence.winter.3: The sick have fewer blankets. Purchased provisions restore part of the reserve.
response.winter.4: Move camp to the winter pastures
consequence.winter.4: The herd is within reach without opening stores. Families lose their shelter and dispute where to settle.
consequence.shortage.4: The ovens receive grain and the town cuts its arrears. Unpaid dock workers protest.
consequence.habitatWorkshop.4: Central habitats resume service. The outer greenhouse harvest is left waiting.
response.habitatWorkshop.5: Lend harbour vehicles to the greenhouses
consequence.habitatWorkshop.5: The harvest resumes. Medical convoys wait longer to unload.
debt.preview: {reason} In {era}: +{points} to the {family} crisis ({total} deferred in total).
debt.danger: At current levels, entering the next era will bring the {family} crisis to 100.
log.debtCollapse: Decisions made in the previous era bring {name} to 100. The civilization dissolves.
deferred.servers.1: The network stays open today. The next administration must fund conversion of the habitats’ archives.
